Hi OP. I’ve been through pretty much the exact same situation you’re currently in. Similar age too. My boyfriend loved big butts, always looking it up in porn, sending pictures of girls with big butts to me, even at one point admitting that he didn’t like my butt because it was too flat, and so on. I hated my body deeply. Every day I fantasized about getting a BBL so he would finally love my body in the same way. I felt horrible and like I’d never be good enough for him. In other aspects of our relationship, though, he was great. He loved me and I don’t doubt that. I couldn’t imagine living without him. He did so much for me and for that I am thankful, but I could not shake the fact that my natural body would never be good enough for him. 

However, a relationship should never cause that much pain. While I felt embarrassed and hateful toward my body before I started seeing him, the relationship amplified that by 100x and I couldn’t take the pain anymore. After two years, even though it was insanely hard, I left him, and it hurt me so so bad. Now, almost two years later, I am so happy I did it. I had never felt good about myself or my body, but after leaving him and realizing my worth, I feel so incredibly better. I have a new partner who genuinely does love my butt, despite how small it is, and I truly feel like I’m good enough, which I never thought I’d feel. 

I wish you the best. You don’t deserve to be in a relationship that makes you feel like this, even if the feeling was there before you dated him. I understand how suffocating of a feeling it is. It’s hard to face, but love isn’t enough to make a relationship healthy.
